generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per the State Government Circular No.FD.295.Expenditure-12 2019 Dt.26-03-2019 any EMD Related exemption certificate will not be considered for this Tender notification
GST Registration from Competent authority is compulsory

As per Karnataka State Government orderNo.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund. The tenderer shall abide by the directions of Government towards recovery as modified by the Government from time to time
For Other Necessary Document as per Tender Bid Document KW1 and Notification Addendum/Corrigendum will be published in the office notice board for all modifications/corrections, if any

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The P.R.E.D. or PWD Contractor Civil Registration Certificate Government

Annual Turnover Certificate in all classes of Civil Engineering works only for last Five Financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 Certified from Charted Accountant Profit and Loss, balance sheet shall be enclosed and UDI number
The works is reserved for Cat-2A Contractors tenderers only. Hence the tenderers should upload the original Cast Certificate issued by the competent authority

Schedule Caste / Schedule Tribes / Reserved Catagory Contractor should be domicile of the State of Karnataka only for more than 10 years. For the proof Residential Certificate issued by the competent authority should be uploaded.

Tender Capacity as per KW1/KW2for Schedule Caste / Schedule Tribes /Reserved Catagory Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than or Equal to the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under for General Assessed available tender Bid Document KW1/KW2 and also mentioned in Notification

As per PWD Code 251Jurisdiction Contractors registered under class I and II may ender for works anywhere in the state. Contractors registered under class III may tender for works within the districts of the Public works Department circles wherein they are registered. Contractors registered under Class IV may tender for works within the district or within the division whichever is applicable, where they are registered These registrations are valid for all
For Other Necessary Document as per Tender Bid Document KW/KW2 and Notification
